sources: https://www.monroecounty.gov/mcparks/reserve/camp (Monroe County's campsite reservation map for Webster Park)

values.note: Monroe County's online reservation system, or the campground (585) 269-4544 during the season. Weekend reservations must cover both Friday and Saturday; when a holiday falls on Monday, Friday through Sunday. Camping by reservation only.

booking.source: https://www.monroecounty.gov/mcparks/reserve/camp ('Weekend reservations must be made for both Friday and Saturday (no one night weekend reservations). When a holiday falls on Monday, the reservation must be made for three days (Friday, Saturday and Sunday).') + https://www.monroecounty.gov/parks-webster ('click here for our online reservations system. During the camping season (May 1st until October 31st) you can call the Campground directly at (585) 269-4544'; 'Camping (by reservation only)'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.monroecounty.gov/parks-webster ('During the camping season (May 1st until October 31st)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The reservation map lists 38 sites: 14 for RV/motorhome/large trailer (26 ft or more), 4 for any pop-up, camper, RV or trailer, 2 for anything, and 18 for tents, pop-ups, campers and small trailers up to 25 ft.

sites.source: https://www.monroecounty.gov/mcparks/reserve/camp (Site #1 - #38 list: 'RV/Motorhome/Large Trailer (26' or more)' 14, 'Pop-up/Camper/RV/Motorhome/Small or Large Trailer' 4, 'Anything (Tent/Camper/Trailer/Etc.)' 2, 'Tent/Pop-up/Camper/Small Trailer (up to 25')' 17, 'Pop-up/Camper/Small Trailer (up to 25')' 1), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.monroecounty.gov/mcparks/reserve/camp (campsite images: 'Restrooms, Showers, Outdoor Sink') + https://www.monroecounty.gov/parks-camping ('The dump station is free for to campers ... dump station is closed during the winter season'), read 2026-10-21

note: Monroe County park on the shore of Lake Ontario; the campground loop is set back above the lake. Sites reported all electric (no sewer). Out-of-county +$10/night. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm reservation-only camping May 1 - Oct 31 (season dates new) on the county's own system; NEW weekend 2-night / Monday-holiday 3-night minimum; the reservation map lists 38 sites (was 46, derived) incl. 14 for rigs 26 ft+; showers and dump added. Note: dropped the site count, booking and season restatements. Not stated on the county pages: rates (the county's 'Camp Site Pricing Sheet' PDF now returns an HTML page), electric amperage, max length (40 ft, derived, left).
flags: No dated official rate: the county's Webster camping pricing sheet (monroecounty.gov/files/parks/Webster/camping/Camp Site Pricing Sheet.pdf) no longer serves a PDF and the reservation and park pages post no price; the note's 'Out-of-county +$10/night' could not be re-confirmed.
